[h3]🌿 The spring is here, and May 3rd is getting closer and closer - get ready to dive into the vortex of creativity to celebrate Polish gamedev![/h3]

[b]It was the third day of May of the year 1791[/b] when the Polish Constitution was signed. It was a modern constitution seeking to implement wide state reforms, advancing democratization of Poland, and including checks and balances and tripartite separation of powers. It was the first such document in Europe, and the [i]second[/i] in the world, following the American one from 1787. To this day, we're celebrating it as one of the [b]peak[/b] achievements of the [i]Age of Enlightenment[/i] in Poland and the foundations of Polish democracy. 

[hr][/hr]

☀️ While historically, 3 May is a very important holiday, we celebrate it in different ways. We quite often take advantage of the warm sun of May and spring in full bloom, lighting up that grill and gathering for a BBQ ♨️ We can't back this up with any scientific data, but this could be the period when most Polish gamers are finally touching grass!

Of course, each to their own, and if you need to take a break from the sun for a bit so you won't overheat, there are also many ways to celebrate indoors! 🥳

🕹️Once again, [b]Acram Digital[/b] is hosting [b]Polish Constitution Days[/b] on Steam to celebrate the rapidly growing Polish gamedev. notes.title: Welcome to Byteland: Part 3 - Power Supply Unit
notes.notes:
[b]Hello Bytelanders![/b]

I have some electrifying news for you! Our next journey is just around the corner and, oh boy, it will be an energizing one! What? Oh… ok, sorry. Allprocesing Elder just told me that my puns are not that funny. So let me just prepare the great spritefire, because the Power Supply Unit awaits.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43041015/b148f25e26c2bcaeb0a7c8e81e91caec2f99724c.png[/img]

The bowels of the machine. The spookiest biome, which might seem foreboding to outsiders. Dark and stormy. Its components are more electrical than electronic, a landscape of huge towers (capacitors) and other large structures (inductors, transformers), lightning striking between them. The Secondary Side feels like a once wild and rural place that is now something of a barren, industrialized area, whereas the Primary Side is densely industrial, like a factory.

Citibots and Fixbots of the Power Supply Unit live in an environment that is less hospitable and comfortable than those of the other biomes. They are very alert and attuned to their surroundings, and likely remain calm in times of stress and sudden changes of fortune. Bots of PSU are also very tough and mostly well built but don’t be intimidated by them, because underneath this appearance they are good and friendly souls!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43041015/32d25e986e6377258d08b4f082b647bea83bbaa7.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43041015/3a59803c3e45ea9b186c6917ee6f688a9885d088.png[/img]

Boti’s boss and mentor, Kernel is the head of the system’s data couriers. At the older end of middle-aged, almost elderly. Grumpy & curmudgeonly. Growing weary of the ever-increasing pace of digital life and the perceived trivialisation of computer usage. But don’t let looks and attitudes deceive you - Kernel is one the most prominent members of the Byteland society!

notes.title: Welcome to Byteland: Part 2 - Graphics Card City

The great spritefire burns again! That means the Allprocessing Elder is waiting to share with us more of his Byteland wisdom. He is holding a digipartchment with the words Graphics Card City written on it…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43041015/4e4238f0aec4818d74ba691da7fb718c39013412.png[/img]

Ah…, yes, the wonderful Graphic Card city! A flashier, more aesthetic place than the Motherboard, with a different kind of energy. Some parts are sleekly urban, while others have a colorful atmosphere almost like a casino city or nightlife quarter. Its components power the computer’s images and require a lot of cooling, so don’t be surprised to see so many heat sinks, fans and radiators.

It is also the most fashionable biome! Citibots of Graphics Card City are generally more concerned with image and creativity than the Citibots of the Motherboard, some will have an elegant appearance or sport wilder styles to reflect their personal taste. They tend to be outgoing, opinionated, and individualistic. This also goes for some of the Fixbots of GC City! They are artisans who work in an environment that places emphasis on high performance, creativity, flashy projects, and personal service. And you know what they say… “who agrees with whom becomes so”.

[b]Hello Bytelanders![/b]

Come in, come all… sit comfortably around the great spritefire and listen to the wise words of the Allprocessing Elder. Today you will learn about one of the mysterious Byteland locations, the Motherboard Island!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43041015/29891731c9080f576b59173c6e36d40e3ceca639.png[/img]

This is the computer’s main command center, with the energy of a capital city. Boti’s workplace (Chipset) is on the outskirts of the main areas. Motherboard Island, as the name could suggest, includes key parts of the computer’s functioning: CPU, RAM, Storage, and the Network Card. It is the most homely and welcoming of the biomes, even after the ‘great disaster’ causes chaos!

Stay tuned for more[b] Welcome to Byteland[/b] series posts, when you will learn about Boti's homeland and it's interesting characters!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43041015/a2c22385afa2cc7ddf9956d8aecda8179e14741a.png[/img]

In the meantime, jump into our official Discord server to share a word or two with other Bytelanders! Just click [b][url=https://discord.gg/u24UvaHQGm]HERE[/url][/b].

notes.title: Boti: Byteland Overclocked - Demo patch
notes.notes:
Thank you all for playing and enjoying our demo.

But most importantly, thanks for sharing your feedback!

Today we're rolling out an update for our demo, which should let you enjoy it more.

What has changed?

- **Movement Tutorial added** - Boti has some moves, but some of you could feel a bit lost at the beginning of the game. We added a tutorial to help you out with your first jumps in Byteland.
- **Optimization:** We know you need a crispy running game, and with this update, you should see slight improvement in Boti's performance (demo is capped at 60 FPS)
- **UX improved** - you should see more clearly where players' action is required
- **Inverted Controls** added to the settings.
- **When your coop partner joins mid-level all objects should properly load**
- **Light effect on spinning reactor fixed in low and high graphics setting**
- **The water stopped flashing in a low-quality graphics setting**
- **Shadows behave better in low quality settings ("black walls")
- Now that's meta-gaming: A game about saving a cyber world from bugs and viruses gets a whole bunch of minor bug fixes

Please share your feedback and help us improve Boti's adventures

If you like our game don't forget to wishlist!
